metadata.description: Approximate chip-EV fictitious-play strategies in a first-caller preflop abstraction.
metadata.algorithm: Simultaneous best responses to average strategies, running-average step 1/(iteration+2). Initial shove .25 and call .15 for all classes.
metadata.abstraction: Equal starting stacks in BB; opener fold-or-shove; at most first caller; later seats forced fold. Opponent classes sampled independently conditional on opener class and exact opener-card blockers. No card-removal interaction between opponents. Later caller posteriors include earlier fold reach.
metadata.chip_accounting: Pot 1.5BB; hero prior contribution .5 only with one seat behind; last caller BB contributes1, penultimate SB .5, others0. Fold is zero additional EV. Uncalled shove gains1.5. Called opener EV=q*(1.5+hero_remaining+caller_remaining)-hero_remaining.
metadata.call_arrays: call[depth][behind][caller_index][class_index]; caller index is order behind opener, last is BB.
metadata.limitations: Not an equilibrium claim for full Hold'em or proof of convergence; no limps, minraises, overcalls, unequal stacks, antes, ICM, conditional folds before opener, or postflop play. Monte Carlo payoff matrix has sampling error.
metadata.regret_definition: Exact unilateral best-response gain for each player against the resulting independently mixed strategy profile, BB per dealt hand under this abstraction. Player0 opener, followed by callers in order.
